# RK Krackers

> RK Krackers is a premier fireworks and crackers manufacturer and online retailer based in Sivakasi, Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu, India. Established in 1991 at 3/1991 Sivakasi Road, Virudhunagar – 626001.

## About

RK Krackers sells 194+ fireworks and crackers products online at https://rkkrackers.in. Products are manufactured in Sivakasi, the fireworks capital of India. The store ships across Tamil Nadu.

## Product Categories

- **Rockets & Aerial Fireworks** – Sky shots, multi-shot aerial shells (Standard Brand, Joker Brand, Vanitha Brand, Elephant/Mr.Big)
- **Ground Chakkar** – Spinning ground wheels
- **Sparklers** – Wire sparklers, colour sparklers in various lengths
- **Gift Boxes** – Curated gift box assortments for Diwali and celebrations
- **Flower Pots** – Flower pot fireworks, colour flower pots
- **Sound Crackers** – Atom bombs, bijili crackers, garlands

## Pricing

Products range from ₹0 (price on request) to several hundred rupees. Up to 30% discount on select items. GST of 28% is applied at checkout.
